written.headline: Databento raises $100M Series C at $1.1B valuation
written.summary: Market data platform Databento raised a $100 million Series C round at a $1.1 billion valuation, led by Fifth Down Capital. The company reports it has doubled its revenue since its Series B round and holds enterprise contracts with five of the six largest frontier AI labs.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick on agent swarm research traffic and Fable 5.2
written.summary: Ethan Mollick reported that agent swarms conducting research generate large volumes of traffic and use repeated full-text searches to find information. He used Claude Fable 5.2 to reconstruct W.H. Auden's 1941 poetry class by having it read an obscure book from the Internet Archive line by line.

written.headline: Nvidia open-source strategy questioned following Jensen Huang's resignation
written.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, leaving Colette Kress to take over as interim chief. His departure raises questions about Nvidia's future support for open-source AI initiatives, open-weight models, and related startup investments.
